Rivers State Governor, Sir Siminalayi Fubara has expressed condolences to the family of late elder statesman and former diplomat, Ambassador Patrick Dele Cole over his demise.
Fubara, in a condolence message he personally signed, described the late Cole as a distinguished son of Rivers State.
The message reads in part: “On behalf of the government of Rivers State, I express my deepest condolences to the Cole family over the transition to glory of our beloved elder statesman, and distinguished son of Rivers State, Ambassador Dele Cole, who was called to glory on Saturday.
“Ambassador Dele Cole was a cerebral diplomat, an accomplished journalist, author, and administrator who devoted his entire life to the service of our dear nation.
“From his days as a Special Adviser to the President on International Relations, to his tour of duty as Nigeria’s Ambassador to Brazil and Argentina, he served with uncommon patriotism, dignity, and excellence.
“He was a man of great intellect and moral standing, whose interventions in national discourse were always illuminating, objective and deeply patriotic. He belonged to that rare generation of Nigerians who put country above self.
“As a government and as a people, we in Rivers State are proud of him and his contributions to the development of our region and the nation at large.
“His death is a monumental loss not only to his immediate family but to Rivers State and Nigeria as a whole, especially at this time when we need the wisdom of elder statesmen to navigate our nation through its present challenges.
“On behalf of the government and the good people of Rivers State, I convey my heartfelt condolences to his beloved wife, children, the entire Cole family, and to all who mourn this irreplaceable loss.
“I pray that the Almighty God will grant his gentle soul eternal rest and grant the family the fortitude to bear this painful exit.”
